info.title: Schemantic.Cli
info.description: Multi-database schema documentation tool (SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite). Outputs Markdown, JSON, or HTML (with a Mermaid ER diagram); optional include/exclude filtering and opt-in LLM table summaries (Ollama / OpenAI-compatible).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Reads database schema metadata and writes documentation.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string for the target database.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (default: schema.md or schema.json based on --format).

options.name: --schema
options.description: Oracle schema owner to read (optional; defaults to the connected user).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a JSON config file with include/exclude schema and table filters.

options.name: --interpret
options.description: Add AI-generated table summaries via a local/remote LLM (opt-in). [default: False]

options.name: --llm-provider
options.description: LLM backend when --interpret is set: ollama | openai. [default: ollama]

options.name: --llm-api-key
options.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (ignored by Ollama).
